bosses.name: Interrogator Vishas
bosses.general: Shadow Word: Pain on the tank. Easy.

bosses.name: Bloodmage Thalnos
bosses.general: Flame Spike leaves fire on the ground, Fire Nova around him, Shadow Bolt.
bosses.tank: Move him out of his Flame Spikes.
bosses.healer: Step out of the fire, heal the nova.
bosses.dps: Step out of the Flame Spike, interrupt his bolts.

bosses.name: Azshir the Sleepless
bosses.general: Rare: a fear and a soul drain.

bosses.name: Houndmaster Loksey
bosses.general: Comes with three Scarlet Trackers (dogs) and Bloodlust.
bosses.tank: Grab the three dogs with him.

bosses.name: Arcanist Doan
bosses.general: At half health he shields himself and then casts a big Arcane Explosion around him. Polymorph and Silence.
bosses.tank: When the bubble goes up, run away from him with everyone, then pull him back.
bosses.healer: Run away with the group when he bubbles; dispel polymorph.
bosses.dps: Melee leave when he casts the explosion; interrupt his casts.

bosses.name: Herod
bosses.general: Whirlwind cuts everyone in melee, he enrages at low health. When he dies a wave of Scarlet Trainees runs in.
bosses.tank: Stay on him through the Whirlwind; afterwards gather the trainees for area attacks.
bosses.healer: Heal the tank hard during Whirlwind; be ready for the trainee wave.
bosses.dps: Melee step away during Whirlwind; then area attacks on the trainees.

bosses.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
bosses.general: Paladin: Crusader Strike, Hammer of Justice, Lay on Hands. When he dies Whitemane comes, puts us to sleep and raises him.
bosses.tank: Hold Mograine; when he is raised pick him up again.
bosses.healer: Expect the Deep Sleep; heal the tank as soon as you wake.
bosses.dps: Kill Mograine, then again after Whitemane raises him, then Whitemane.

bosses.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
bosses.general: Deep Sleep on the whole group, then she resurrects Mograine. Heals and Power Word: Shield.
bosses.healer: Dispel her shield if you can.
bosses.dps: Interrupt her heals and the resurrection; kill Mograine again, then her.

bosses.name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
bosses.general: Hidden behind the cathedral: fear, curses and dispels.
